svg.text: Chen notation · cardinalities read across the relationship (e.g. 1 user — N posts)
Double line = total participation (every instance takes part)
ISA = subtype (apex points to the supertype)
• Likes are M:N → junction tables post_likes / comment_likes
• FOLLOWS is a self-referencing M:N; CHECK follower ≠ following.
• MODERATORS is a subtype of USERS (user_id is PK and FK).
• Each report targets exactly one of post / comment / reply
(3 nullable FKs + CHECK exactly one is NOT NULL).
• REVIEWS is optional per report: reviewed_by is NULL until
• Only posts and comments can be liked (replies cannot).
• liked_at is stored on the like relationships (post_likes / comment_likes).
• Double lines (total participation) = NOT NULL foreign keys:
